item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 9 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 9 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 29 October 2026(Thursday)

Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Polillo, Calauag, Alabat, Quezon, Perez, Burdeos, Guinayangan, Lopez, Tagkawayan, San Narciso, San Andres, Mauban) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
